studio_step: STUDIO-006 automatic recurring and guest voice casting
rules: Preschool/toddler voices explicitly forbid adult timbre and adult falsetto imitation.
Newborn/young infant characters route to coos/babble/cry SFX instead of adult-like sentence TTS.
Guest characters are episode-scoped by default and receive stable IDs before final dialogue generation.
Speaking human guests require explicit age/stage and gender presentation in scenario metadata.
Elder voices are natural and respectful, not caricatures.
Non-talking pets use species vocalizations; talking animals use voice design plus species SFX.
The production flow is two-pass: guest-cast outline -> materialize visual/voice identities -> final story script with expanded allowed cast.

examples.police: adult/age and gender from script -> professional natural voice
examples.care_home: elder age and gender from script -> respectful older voice
examples.pet: species + talking flag -> animal vocalization or talking-animal voice
